build_dataset_from_catalog: build a dataset by calling DatasetCatalog.build with a name, root path, and split like train val or test
list_supported_datasets: list all supported dataset names from the DatasetCatalog.CONSTRUCTORS dictionary keys
lookup_dataset_splits: lookup the official train val and test split names for a dataset using DatasetCatalog.SPLITS
get_num_classes: get the number of classes for an image classification dataset from DatasetCatalog.NUM_CLASSES
build_dataset_with_transform: build a dataset with a custom transform by passing it to DatasetCatalog.build as the transform argument
